in_marathi.name: शरद
in_marathi.long_meaning: शरद हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। शरदः (Sharadah) is a Sanskrit word that represents autumn and the maturity that comes with it. This name is associated with the goddess Sharada, who is the embodiment of knowledge, wisdom, and creativity. It is believed that the name Sharada brings blessings of intelligence, prosperity, and longevity.
